directAnswer.en: This is repair, repointing or a small patch, not a full building frame. Stay inside particle ≤8 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3 and 5 m³/h. That particle window is not a 24 mm structural stone line. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine at 380 V, all-copper dual motors 7.5/9 kW, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, 100 m horizontal / 50 m vertical, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤8 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1500 × 700 × 1100 mm and 295 kg. Do not move the same condition onto Type 311, which prints 220/380 V, 4 kW, 2 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 15 m horizontal / 5 m vertical, hose 25 mm, particle ≤2 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1500 × 420 × 900 mm and 150 kg. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.

heading.en: What the repair material has to match

body.en: This is repair, repointing or a small patch, not a full building frame. Stay inside particle ≤8 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3 and 5 m³/h. That particle window is not a 24 mm structural stone line. The published Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine row is 380 V, all-copper dual motors 7.5/9 kW, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, 100 m horizontal / 50 m vertical, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤8 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1500 × 700 × 1100 mm and 295 kg.
body.zh: 这是修缮、勾缝或小块修补，不是整栋建筑结构。留在粒径 ≤8 mm、砂灰比 ≤1:3、5 m³/h 里面。这个粒径窗口不是 24 mm 的结构石子管路。已公布的液压混凝土喷涂机是380V、全铜双电机 7.5/9 kW、5 m³/h、8 MPa、水平 100 m / 垂直 50 m、管径 38/51 mm、粒径 ≤8 mm、砂灰比 ≤1:3、外形 1500 × 700 × 1100 mm、295 kg。
